notes: Shock: X1, X2 and X3 run the same model and fail on the same day.
Y1 lent 5 to each of them. It loses 3 × (0.8 × 5) = 12, more than its capital 10, so it fails. Y2 lent 5 to X3 and loses 4, below its capital 9.
Y1 has failed. Y2 lent 10 to Y1 and loses 0.8 × 10 = 8 more: 4 + 8 = 12 ≥ 9, so Y2 fails. Y3 lent 5 to Y1 and loses 4, below 11.
Y2 has failed. Y3 lent 10 to Y2 and loses 8 more: 4 + 8 = 12 ≥ 11, so Y3 fails. All six banks have failed. Check: the widget says 6 of 6 in 3 rounds.
